This pump is used to forwarding 
 solar fuel oil from large tank of station to unit tank

This document outlines the equipment inspection list I3, which 
 must be carried out every month as indicated by Y1 in the above title block.

The first draft initiated by eng. Shady Ghazy and tested by 
 maintenance manager eng. Abd El Rahman Nasar and revised by maintenance 
 general manager: eng. Omran Abd El Hamid Shoaib 
 approved by Eng.Ahmed Sawan Nubria power station head sector and
 revised by MDEPC quality control eng. Abouda El Bana 
 &, and certified by eng. Samir Abd Algalil inspection & quality control 
 general director, MPIS coordinator approved by eng. 
 Mohamed Nagieb INSP. And quality control head sector

items:
A work permit must be issued and 
 the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category

Safety fence with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area is required

Wear safety and healthy equipment 
 as safety helmet, safety shoes breathing mask ... etc

Isolate the circuit breaker of 
 the pump motor

Disconnect electric terminals of 
 the pump motor

The pump must be isolated 
 mechanically by closing delivery and suction valves
Complete maintenance tool set.
Straight edge, rugs, cleaning fluid

Measure vibrations level for bearings. and compare it with the 
 setting value

Check discharge quantity and 
 pressure.
 and compare it with the setting value

Check Any Leakage From Pump & Piping flanges and re-tight 
 (if it is needed)
Measuring bearing temperature

Check glands for leaking then
 re-tight it (if it is needed)
Replace oil of pump
Replace rubber pads in coupling
Replace gland packing

Check alignment and compare it with 
 the setting value

Check the pump casing against rust 
 and re-paint (if it is needed)

Check bolt fixation then 
 re-tightens it (if it is needed)

Clean external part with compressed 
 air

text:
Power 
 Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This pump is used to forwarding 
 solar fuel oil from large tank of station to unit tank
This document outlines the equipment inspection list I3, which 
 must be carried out every month as indicated by Y1 in the above title block.
The first draft initiated by eng. Shady Ghazy and tested by 
 maintenance manager eng. Abd El Rahman Nasar and revised by maintenance 
 general manager: eng. Omran Abd El Hamid Shoaib 
 approved by Eng.Ahmed Sawan Nubria power station head sector and
 revised by MDEPC quality control eng. Abouda El Bana 
 &, and certified by eng. Samir Abd Algalil inspection & quality control 
 general director, MPIS coordinator approved by eng. 
 Mohamed Nagieb INSP. And quality control head sector
Technical Specifications
QUANTITY | 3
MANUFACTUR | BOMBAS ITUR, ISPAN
TYPE | NO-80/250BC
FLOW | 145 m 3/h
Pressure | 8.5 BAR
MOTOR (KW) | 41
Safety 
Precautions
A work permit must be issued and 
 the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category
Safety fence with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area is required
Wear safety and healthy equipment 
 as safety helmet, safety shoes breathing mask ... etc
Isolate the circuit breaker of 
 the pump motor
Disconnect electric terminals of 
 the pump motor
The pump must be isolated 
 mechanically by closing delivery and suction valves
Tools 
and Equipment
Complete maintenance tool set.
Straight edge, rugs, cleaning fluid
Work to be 
carried out
Pump in 
 operation
Measure vibrations level for bearings. and compare it with the 
 setting value
Check discharge quantity and 
 pressure.
 and compare it with the setting value
Check Any Leakage From Pump & Piping flanges and re-tight 
 (if it is needed)
Measuring bearing temperature
Check glands for leaking then
 re-tight it (if it is needed)
Pump out of operation
Replace oil of pump
Replace rubber pads in coupling
Replace gland packing
Check alignment and compare it with 
 the setting value
Check the pump casing against rust 
 and re-paint (if it is needed)
Check bolt fixation then 
 re-tightens it (if it is needed)
Clean external part with compressed 
 air
Starting the Pump
Before starting the pump, the following steps should be checked
Open the suction and delivery 
 valves of the pump.
Connect electric terminal of the 
 pump motor.
Check the direction of rotation.
Attendance and checking during 
operation
Check the temperature of the bearing
Check the oil level in bearing
Check the vibration of the pump
Check discharge quantity and pressure
